comments.text: Santa Cruz del Islote breaks every rule of modern living: over 1,000 people packed onto 2 acres with no cars, no police, no cemetery , and showering with seawater just to save rainwater —yet they somehow have 24-hour free Wi-Fi  and a tighter sense of community than most big cities. Be honest: could you handle zero privacy in exchange for living in a place where everyone has your back
